$comment: Species (CONTRACT §8.1). size m (adult height); speed = × the base walk of 0.25 m/tick; swim = × speed in water (0 = cannot); lifespan / maturity / elder in years of the planet; fertility = births per couple per year at plenty; diet = food tag weights (what they eat and how much they like it); forage = food sources (vegetation, sea, air); temp = [min, comfortLo, comfortHi, max] °C (outside comfort warmth drains; beyond min/max it kills without shelter, fire or clothes); breathes o2 | methane | none; habitat land, coast, water, cold; needs = weights of the shared needs (+ species needs wetness / methane / hive); decay = per-day rate multipliers; traits = means 0..1; colours for bodygen; phonology = names.json id; style = building materials in preference order + form hints; taboos / sacred seed the culture; god = awe / fear sensitivity to the player's acts; start = innate knowledge (recipe ids) of a stone-age band.
name: Plains folk
desc: Upright, curious generalists of grass and river country. They walk far, eat almost anything, and talk to everything.
